verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an API reference covering the HTTP, Pixel, Event Audit, transformations, usage-metrics and audit-log APIs, and offers an Event Playground app for sending sample events without instrumentation. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: interactive in-docs request console, runnable code examples within the API reference, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
